# Uphance

> > Uphance is an all-in-one ERP and PLM platform designed specifically for apparel brands to manage production, inventory, orders, and global operations.

Uphance provides cloud-based enterprise resource planning (ERP) and product lifecycle management (PLM) software tailored for the fashion and apparel industry. The platform integrates with QuickBooks, Xero, Shopify, and other systems to streamline manufacturing, supply chain management, inventory control, and multi-entity operations for clothing brands worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Apparel ERP
- Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
- Inventory Management
- Supply Chain Management
- Fashion Manufacturing
- Order Fulfillment
- Warehouse Management
- Multi-Entity Operations
- QuickBooks Integration
- Garment Costing & Pricing
- Production Management
- Work-in-Progress (WIP) Inventory
- Inventory Optimization
- E-commerce Integration
- Apparel Fulfillment
